user.title: Wakey
user.description: Wakey adds an alarm clock to Home Assistant. There is nothing to configure here — alarms are managed after setup.

time.name: Time
time.description: Local wall-clock time the alarm goes off.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Fire once on a given date, or weekly on the selected days.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days to fire on when repeating weekly.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to fire on when repeat is set to once.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Speaker to play on. For Music Assistant sources this must be a Music Assistant player.

source_uri.name: Source
source_uri.description: A Music Assistant URI such as library://track/6018, a media content ID, or search text.

fade_seconds.name: Fade in
fade_seconds.description: Seconds to ramp from quiet up to the target volume. 0 starts at full volume.

resume_previous.name: Resume previous playback
resume_previous.description: Put back whatever the speaker was already playing once the alarm is dismissed or snoozed. Music Assistant sources only.

auto_dismiss_minutes.name: Auto dismiss
auto_dismiss_minutes.description: Stop by itself after this long if nobody dismisses it.

pre_alarm_minutes.name: Pre-alarm lead time
pre_alarm_minutes.description: Run the pre-alarm script this many minutes before the alarm. 0 disables it.

pre_alarm_script.name: Pre-alarm script
pre_alarm_script.description: Script to run before the alarm, for sunrise lights or heating.

notify_targets.name: Notify on ring
notify_targets.description: Send a push notification with Dismiss/Snooze actions to these notify targets when the alarm rings.

owner_id.name: Owner
owner_id.description: Home Assistant user this alarm belongs to. Only administrators can set it; leave it empty for a household alarm that only administrators see.

update.name: Update alarm
update.description: Changes fields on an existing alarm. Only the fields you supply are altered.

time.name: Time
time.description: Local wall-clock time the alarm goes off.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Fire once on a given date, or weekly on the selected days.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days to fire on when repeating weekly.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to fire on when repeat is set to once.

source_uri.name: Source
source_uri.description: Music Assistant URI, media content ID, or search text.

fade_seconds.name: Fade in
fade_seconds.description: Seconds to ramp up to the target volume.

resume_previous.name: Resume previous playback
resume_previous.description: Put back what the speaker was playing when the alarm ends.

auto_dismiss_minutes.name: Auto dismiss
auto_dismiss_minutes.description: Stop by itself after this long.

pre_alarm_minutes.name: Pre-alarm lead time
pre_alarm_minutes.description: Run the pre-alarm script this many minutes before the alarm. 0 disables it.

pre_alarm_script.name: Pre-alarm script
pre_alarm_script.description: Script to run before the alarm.

notify_targets.name: Notify on ring
notify_targets.description: Send a push notification with Dismiss/Snooze actions to these notify targets when the alarm rings.

owner_id.name: Owner
owner_id.description: Home Assistant user this alarm belongs to. Only administrators can set it; leave it empty for a household alarm that only administrators see.

delete.name: Delete alarm
delete.description: Removes an alarm and its entities.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Silences a ringing alarm and brings it back shortly.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: Leave empty to snooze whatever is currently ringing.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Override the alarm's own snooze length.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Stops a ringing alarm until its next occurrence.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: Leave empty to dismiss everything currently ringing.

skip_next.name: Skip next
skip_next.description: Skips the next occurrence only, then resumes as normal.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Turn off to cancel a previously requested skip.

trigger_now.name: Trigger now
trigger_now.description: Fires an alarm immediately. Useful for checking that a speaker and source actually work.
